# ClinSight - Clinical Trials Intelligence Engine
> Fast, programmatic clinical evidence and protocol benchmarks for computational biologists, regulatory professionals, and scientific founders.

## Overview
ClinSight indexes pivotal Phase 3 and registrational clinical studies across high-impact modalities:
- Bispecific Antibodies & T-Cell Engagers (Teclistamab, Elranatamab, Talquetamab, Epcoritamab, Glofitamab, Mosunetuzumab)
- Cell & Gene Therapy (CAR-T: Cilta-cel, Ide-cel, Axi-cel, Liso-cel)
- Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs: T-DXd, Polatuzumab, Belantamab mafodotin, EV)
- Targeted Oncology (TKIs, Menin inhibitors, BTK/BCL2 inhibitors, KRAS, PARP inhibitors)
- Targeted Monoclonal Antibodies (Daratumumab, Isatuximab, Obinutuzumab)
- Checkpoint Inhibitors & Immuno-Oncology (PD-1 / PD-L1)
- Incretin Mimetics (GLP-1 / GIP Dual Agonists)

- [NCT02367040 (CHRONOS-3)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT02367040/): Copanlisib and Rituximab in Relapsed Indolent B-cell Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma (iNHL). Phase: Phase 3, Modality: Targeted Monoclonal Antibodies, Sponsor: Bayer.
- [NCT02500407](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT02500407/): A Safety, Efficacy and Pharmacokinetic Study of BTCT4465A (Mosunetuzumab) as a Single Agent and Combined With Atezolizumab in Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma (NHL) and Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL). Phase: Phase 1, Phase 2, Modality: Bispecific Antibodies & T-Cell Engagers, Sponsor: Genentech, Inc..
- [NCT03888105 (ELM-2)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03888105/): A Study to Assess the Anti-Tumor Activity and Safety of Odronextamab in Adult Patients With B-cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma Who Have Been Previously Treated With Other Cancer Therapies. Phase: Phase 2, Modality: Bispecific Antibodies & T-Cell Engagers, Sponsor: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals.
- [NCT03105336 (ZUMA-5)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03105336/): A Study of Axicabtagene Ciloleucel in Participants With Relapsed/Refractory Indolent Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma. Phase: Phase 2, Modality: Cell & Gene Therapy (CAR-T), Sponsor: Kite, A Gilead Company.
